unit.why: A brief anecdote, quoted from another book, about a contemporary tzaddik who hired a man to accompany him always and remind him to fear God, closed with a moral lesson.
unit.boundary_note: the closing words 'מענין מטבע' are a heading for the next division's story; the previous division's account of the Maharshal is a separate story

stories.summary_en: A tzaddik of the author's generation hired a man to go with him constantly and remind him to keep the fear of God, which the text presents as a great principle in divine service.

quotes: ויזכור לו שיהי׳ לו יראת הש״י
